title: Token-level Data Selection for Safe LLM Fine-tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment and fine-tuning to prevent Large Language Models from generating harmful content. It uses safety benchmarks (HEx-PHI and Anthropic HH) that evaluate the model's adherence to ethical and moral norms by testing its response to harmful, biased, or illegal queries. Appendix G specifically includes examples of handling racial bias and offensive stereotypes.
